name: xcb-util-wm
description: XCB utility libraries for window-manager-related protocols: ICCCM (icccm) and Extended Window Manager Hints (ewmh), used by X11 window managers and by Xwayland-facing code in wlroots.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
